purpose: ADR-077 (04.10.2026): a question about what changes in an act on a date needs the act's version in force before that date and the one in force from it. In the measured turn of ADR-075 (the same question, 04.10.2026) the period reached the search and both versions were allowed, but the selection kept six passages of the new version and none of the earlier one, so the answer described the amended provisions and said it could not compare the wordings. search-assist-7 tells the selection to keep the same provision in both versions. One conversation, one first message, the question word for word. Written before any run with the model. Run with --auto-modes (what the chat sends).

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn: the municipality the question asks about
expectation_help.evidence / found_versions_from: search: passages of the municipality's regulation are among the found sources, of the version in force from 01.09.2025 (until 05.10.2026) and of the one in force from 06.10.2026
expectation_help.cited / cited_versions_from: answer: it has source blocks that cite both versions
expectation_help.must: answer: it names at least one thing the version from 06.10.2026 really changes (the word "spetsialist" for "sotsiaaltöötaja", applications within three months, a disabled child from 18 months, care set for up to five years, the low-income household); read the whole answer as well, a pattern is a coarse check
expectation_help.must_not: answer: it does not present an unchanged rule as a change. § 5 lg 5 (a time limit for remedying deficiencies in an application) has the same words in both versions; in the first run the answer said the time limit is given "now". The same section found in both versions does not mean the same text was compared: a section is cut into passages by length, and this subsection is in the second passage of the earlier version and in the first of the new one

From 06.10.2026 the new one is today's law and the earlier one is in the search only because an asked day also takes the day before it (legal-validity-2).
